decisions.reason: Adding a green level-4 graphic bullet changes visual styling but does not change the existing Tab-key or hierarchy behavior.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records the green level-4 bullet and image/table text style as required style additions.
The newly specified bullet appearance does not change the required legacy copy-paste behavior, test sources, or target template version.
The missing style details do not alter the scope, method, time budget, or outputs of the initial assessment deliverable.
The requirement to include the existing template theme colors was already established, and message 71 reports their absence without changing the required palette state.
The bullet and style specifications do not change manual line-break behavior after pasted content.
The image/table label typography in message 71 does not change the requirement that table layouts remain within page bounds during paste.
Image and table text labels are distinct from the interactive-field help labels governed by this Requirement.
The client directly specifies the typography required for image and table label text, adding a new typography value to this Requirement.
